title: Hybrid Joint-Selective Optimization: Reduced-Space Levenberg-Marquardt Refinement of Low-Dimensional Parameters of Interest
abstract: arXiv:2609.37308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid joint-selective optimization (HJSO) framework for large-scale numerical problems in which a small subset of trainable quantities is of primary interest. We partition the full parameter vector into a high-dimensional remaining block and a low-dimensional block of parameters of interest (POIs), perform joint first-order optimization over the full parameter set, and then freeze the remaining variables while applying a reduced-space Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) refinement to the POIs. The method is designed for settings in which the POIs are low-dimensional but strongly influence the quality of the computed solution, while the full parameter space remains too large for full-space second-order methods. The framework is evaluated on three representative problems: a matrix eigenvalue problem, an inverse Bratu problem solved with a physics-informed neural network, and a 100-dimensional nonlinear Black-Scholes problem

translated_title: 混合联合-选择性优化：对低维关注参数的降空间Levenberg-Marquardt精化
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种面向大规模数值问题的混合联合-选择性优化（HJSO）框架，适用于一小部分可训练量为主要关注对象的场景。我们将完整的参数向量划分为一个高维的剩余块和一个低维的关注参数（POIs）块，先在整个参数集上执行联合一阶优化，然后冻结剩余变量，仅对关注参数应用降空间Levenberg-Marquardt（LM）精化。该方法专为以下场景设计：关注参数虽然是低维的，却对计算解的质量有强烈影响，而完整的参数空间对于全空间二阶方法而言仍然过于庞大。该框架在三个代表性问题上进行了评估：矩阵特征值问题、利用物理信息神经网络求解的逆Bratu问题，以及一个100维的非线性Black-Scholes问题。
tldr: 该论文提出混合联合-选择性优化（HJSO）框架，先对全部参数进行联合一阶优化，再冻结其余变量、仅对低维关注参数施加降空间Levenberg-Marquardt二阶精化，从而在大规模数值问题中高效提升关键解的质量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Hybrid Joint-Selective Optimization (HJSO) framework that first performs joint first-order optimization over all parameters, then freezes the rest and applies reduced-space Levenberg-Marquardt refinement to only the low-dimensional parameters of interest, efficiently improving solution quality in large-scale numerical problems.
